## History

Wiggins's neighbor, Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), reported that he sold off everything from his farm that could possibly be sold. As a result of these frugal habits, he raised his family on skim milk.

_Sources: [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P32](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0032)_
